description: Read a URL with the user's cookies, no tab needed: a site's feed, export, print view or JSON API, as its own page would ask. Much faster than opening pages; a skill's `read:` lines say which addresses give what. GET goes anywhere; POST only to a read a skill lists (body is JSON unless type says). HTML comes back as its text unless html is true. With tab, it runs inside that page instead (same site only). Returns status, type and up to 1 MB.

html.description: Keep HTML as it is rather than its text

space.description: A space's name, for its sign-ins; without, where the site is signed in

tab.description: Tab id, as `open` or `tabs` gave it

type.description: Content type of a POST body, application/json unless said

name: fetch
title: Fetch URL
